question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**turbulent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Turbulent: Characterized by conflict, disorder, or confusion; not stable or calm (अशांत या अस्त-व्यस्त).
 
• The passage discusses sand and dust storms, which are characterized by strong and chaotic winds.
 
• The correct adjective to describe these winds is "turbulent," which means "violent or unsteady movement of air or water."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tranquil:** Free from disturbance; calm (शांत).
 
• **Laconic:** Using very few words (संक्षिप्त).
 
• **Bane:** A cause of great distress or annoyance (कष्ट).
